# vllm-ascend (OpenSensor fork)

## What it is

A hardware backend plugin for [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) that runs inference on **Huawei Ascend NPUs** (the `910B`/`310P` "Ascend" accelerator family). It is a fork of the upstream `vllm-project/vllm-ascend` project, maintained under the `opensensor` org, with a heavy local divergence: the repo carries its own product requirements (PRDs), design documents, and evaluation harnesses for **310P-targeted** deployments.

The plugin lives in `vllm_ascend/` and is registered into vLLM's platform/worker/model-runner extension points rather than being a standalone server.

## Layout

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `vllm_ascend/worker/` | Worker, model runner (v1/v2), EPLB, KV-cache pool, CPU binding |
| `vllm_ascend/attention/` | Attention backends (FlashAttention variants, MLA, sparse/KV offload) |
| `vllm_ascend/ops/` | Custom Ascend ops (attention, MoE, RMSNorm, RoPE, quant) |
| `vllm_ascend/compilation/` | `torch.compile` integration: ACL graph capture, graph fusion passes, updatable/breakable graphs |
| `vllm_ascend/quantization/` | Quantization support (compressed weights, KV quant) |
| `vllm_ascend/spec_decode/` | Speculative decoding: EAGLE, Medusa, n-gram, MTP, plus several vendor-specific proposers (`dflash`, `dspark`, `gemma4`, `step3p5`) |
| `vllm_ascend/lora/` | LoRA / punica, fused MoE with LoRA |
| `vllm_ascend/sample/` | Custom samplers, penalties, rejection sampling |
| `vllm_ascend/weight_switch/` | Hot weight swapping (linear / `o_proj`) |
| `vllm_ascend/ec_manager/` | External/elastic cache management |
| `vllm_ascend/xlite/` | "XLite" lightweight worker/model-runner path |
| `vllm_ascend/observability/` | Metrics provider, request timing,
